corrections.reason: The third character of አድንኃለሁ ('I will save you') is clearly ን in the image, not a repeated ኃ.
The printed glyphs are እንደ ተፈጸመለት ('that that was fulfilled for him'), where 1st-order ደ and ጸ were misread as 6th-order ድ and 4th-order ጻ.
Classical Ge'ez grammar and the printed glyph show 1st-order ረ in ለዘዕውረ ተወልደ ('for him who was born blind').
